name: External Unable To Apply Missing Data 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason of an unable to apply due to missing data, as published in an external unable to apply missing data code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

MS02.name: Missing Instruction For Next Agent
MS02.definition: Instruction for next agent is missing (former MissingSenderToReceiverInformation split into debtor, credit and next agent information).

MS05.name: Missing Debtor Agent
MS05.definition: DebtorAgent is missing (former MissingFirstAgent for credit transfers).

MS11.name: Missing Third Reimbursement Agent
MS11.definition: Third reimbursement agent is missing (former MissingReimbursementAgent).

MS15.name: Missing Creditor Agent
MS15.definition: Creditor agent is missing (former MissingFirstAgent for direct debits).

MS16.name: Missing Instruction For Creditor Agent
MS16.definition: Instruction for creditor agent is missing (former MissingSenderToReceiverInformation split into debtor, credit and next agent information).

MS17.name: Missing Instruction For Debtor Agent
MS17.definition: Instruction for debtor agent is missing (former MissingSenderToReceiverInformation split into debtor, credit and next agent information).

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: See narrative field for additional information.
